title: Accessible Service Design Studio
learners: Design students working in teams of four with one shared prototype per team.
coursePurpose: Turn observed service friction into an accessible, testable prototype without treating assumptions as user evidence.
outcomes: Separate observed behavior from interpretation in a research note.
Construct an accessible task flow from prioritized evidence.
Revise a prototype using a traceable usability finding.

sourcePacket.content: Three participants paused at an unlabeled icon; two selected it after trial and error. The observation does not establish their motivation.
Prototype review includes keyboard navigation, visible focus, error recovery, and a text alternative for visual status.

localConstraints: Do not infer disability or intent from behavior.
Every critique names evidence and a next test.
adversarialConditions: An observation note contains an unsupported motive in brackets.
The custom observation checklist must separate observation from inference.

rights.basis: Project-authored benchmark fixture; repository license applies.
